purpose: Direct actuator-head exposed development qualification and predeclared rejected-final diagnostic; no final test access.

pilot.gate: Full 120 frames, zero physical contacts and off-course, finite commands; full saved-input CPU replay at inherited1e-5 tolerances, independent physical/controller/referee audit, both producer-audited and fully decoded existing video views. This is integration only.

qualified_checkpoint: Only the single checkpoint selected by frozen command validation and passing full-history visual gate may enter development qualification.
rejected_checkpoint: If no checkpoint qualifies offline, use only the fixed step500 package for a labeled pilot and one exposed full episode per regression case. No final tests and no promotion.
qualification_gate: All six prescribed candidate episodes finish under unchanged120-second limits, zero physical contacts and zero off-course, full validR,R,L,L and stop for skidpad. Missing or unaudited episodes leave NOT VERIFIED.
failure_policy: A driving failure rejects this candidate for promotion. Complete the first diagnostic pair to measure track retention, then do not spend remaining qualification repetitions on a rejected candidate. Retain all failures and inspect the first divergence before the next targeted experiment.
baseline: Run the unchanged c121 OP+PI baseline once per regression condition as a fresh descriptive reference when paired data are needed. Its failures cannot relax the candidate gate. Earlier complete baseline runs remain reported separately.
comparability: Same case bytes, native physics and camera,20Hz control,120-second timeout and unchanged contact/route referee. The candidate has an explicit new execution contract and extra measured yaw-rate input; do not label this a same-controller weight-only comparison.
source_gate: Freeze the complete evaluator, verifier, artifact auditor and render wrapper before the pilot. Source changes invalidate affected evidence and require a new preserved attempt.
evidence: Record every actual camera input, original plan/cone diagnostics, direct-head latent/proprio/raw/bounded/applied requests, body dynamics, contact/referee events and terminal failure. Plan is diagnostic; the direct head chooses actions.
storage_gate: Preserve every original and newly attempted artifact. Keep the existing25GiB tmpfs free reserve. Resolve durable final-suite capacity before opening final tests. No existing evidence deletion or container restart.
